2: /** 缓存容量包含索引开销，单位为 byte。 */
3: export function entryWeight(bytes: number, overhead: number = 0.1, category?: string): number {
4:   if (bytes < 0) throw new RangeError('bytes');
5:   const headers = category === 'image' ? 64 : 24;
6:   const allocated = Math.ceil(bytes * (1 + overhead)) + headers;
7:   return allocated * byteUnit;
8: }
9: export const allocationWeight = entryWeight;
10: export function memoryBudget(bytes: number, overhead: number = 0.1, category?: string) {
11:   const allocated = entryWeight(bytes, overhead, category);
12:   const available = Math.max(0, 1048576 - allocated / byteUnit);
13:   return { allocated, available };
14: }
15: export function remainingBudget(bytes: number): number {
16:   return memoryBudget(bytes, 0.1, 'text').available;
17: }
18: export function growthCost(bytes: number): number {
19:   return allocationWeight(bytes, 0.1, 'text') / byteUnit;
20: }
21: export function largestFit(capacity: number, weights: number[]) {
22:   let remaining = capacity;
23:   const selected: number[] = [];
24:   const ordered = weights.map((weight, index) => ({ weight, index })).sort((a, b) => a.weight - b.weight);
25:   for (const item of ordered) {
26:     if (item.weight < 0) throw new RangeError('negative weight');
27:     if (item.weight > remaining) break;
28:     selected.push(item.index);
29:     remaining -= item.weight;
30:   }
31:   return { selected, remaining };
32: }
33: export function histogram(weights: number[]) {
34:   const buckets = new Map<number, number>();
35:   for (const weight of weights) {
36:     const bucket = weight <= 0 ? 0 : 2 ** Math.ceil(Math.log2(weight));
37:     buckets.set(bucket, (buckets.get(bucket) ?? 0) + 1);
38:   }
39:   return [...buckets].sort(([a], [b]) => a - b);
40: }
41: export function percentile(weights: number[], quantile: number) {
42:   if (!weights.length) return 0;
43:   if (quantile < 0 || quantile > 1) throw new RangeError('quantile');
44:   return [...weights].sort((a, b) => a - b)[Math.ceil(quantile * (weights.length - 1))]!;
45: }
46: export function normalizeWeights(weights: number[]) {
47:   const total = weights.reduce((sum, weight) => sum + weight, 0);
48:   return weights.map((weight) => total ? weight / total : 0);

51: export function selectEntries(capacity: number, entries: Array<{ bytes: number; benefit: number }>) {
52:   if (!Number.isInteger(capacity) || capacity < 0) throw new RangeError('integer capacity');
53:   const values = Array.from({ length: entries.length + 1 }, () => new Float64Array(capacity + 1));
54:   for (let index = 1; index <= entries.length; index += 1) {
55:     const entry = entries[index - 1]!;
56:     if (!Number.isInteger(entry.bytes) || entry.bytes < 1) throw new RangeError('entry bytes');
57:     for (let available = 0; available <= capacity; available += 1) {
58:       const excluded = values[index - 1]![available]!;
59:       const included = entry.bytes <= available ? values[index - 1]![available - entry.bytes]! + entry.benefit : -Infinity;
60:       values[index]![available] = Math.max(excluded, included);
61:     }
62:   }
63:   let remaining = capacity;
64:   const selected: number[] = [];
65:   for (let index = entries.length; index > 0; index -= 1) {
66:     if (values[index]![remaining] !== values[index - 1]![remaining]) {
67:       selected.push(index - 1);
68:       remaining -= entries[index - 1]!.bytes;
69:     }
70:   }
71:   return { selected: selected.reverse(), benefit: values[entries.length]![capacity]!, remaining };
72: }

74: export function fragmentation(blocks: Array<{ start: number; length: number }>, capacity: number) {
75:   const occupied = [...blocks].sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start);
76:   let end = 0;
77:   let free = 0;
78:   let largest = 0;
79:   for (const block of occupied) {
80:     if (block.start < end || block.length <= 0) throw new Error('overlapping memory blocks');
81:     const gap = block.start - end;
82:     free += gap;
83:     largest = Math.max(largest, gap);
84:     end = block.start + block.length;
85:   }
86:   if (end > capacity) throw new RangeError('memory capacity');
87:   free += capacity - end;
88:   largest = Math.max(largest, capacity - end);
89:   return free ? 1 - largest / free : 0;
90: }
